positive_current_findings: EmpiricalPredicate can represent an exact predeclared DERIVED_BRANCH_COHORT with exact member respondent refs and replay/source authority material.
I05 exposes RECURSIVE_SUBGROUP_FORK and BRANCH_CONDITIONED_COTRAVEL candidate families.
I05 composes a selected child predicate with the exact branch baseline under a common same-respondent binding law.
Existing current tests exercise one-generation recursive subgroup conditioning, branch-conditioned cross-question cotravel, VALID_EMPTY, and deterministic frontier/receipt/replay identity.
I05 has exact typed EVALUATED_UNDERPOWERED/INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT logic below the governed minimum_raw_denominator.

first_irreducible_gap.description: A discovered generation-1 child branch is compiled as an internal EmpiricalPredicate and represented in the public receipt by winning_predicate_ref, but the public ExactBoundedDiscoveryResult does not return or resolve that compiled predicate object as a next-generation branch baseline. The ancestry receipt is a set-like pass-through of grammar-supplied ancestry refs rather than an automatically role-bearing immediate-parent lineage. No current public I05 handoff consumes the discovered child receipt to construct generation 2 without caller/private-compiler reconstruction.
why_irreducible: _catalog_atoms for a later invocation requires actual EmpiricalPredicate objects, not a bare ExactRef.
ExactBoundedDiscoveryResult contains receipts/fact refs/frontier/replay identity but no compiled winning-predicate catalog.
DiscoveryResultReceipt.winning_predicate_ref identifies the child but does not make its object resolvable for the next invocation.
branch_or_parent_ancestry_refs is set-like and its contents are supplied by the input atom grammar; it does not itself encode immediate-parent role/order.
the internal DiscoveryBranchReplayBinding has useful parent/winning-predicate fields but is not materialized by current I05 execution and has no current public next-generation consumption contract.

fixture_execution_disposition.stop_reason: The current common public contract cannot lawfully hand the discovered CHILD forward as GRANDCHILD's exact parent without external reconstruction; MX01 stop law requires immediate fail-closed return at that point.
existing_executable_evidence_reused: current exact underpowered terminal code path

minimum_common_delta: Strengthen the common recursive branch handoff/lineage contract so a discovered child predicate is exactly resolvable and reusable, carries role-bearing immediate-parent lineage plus replay-equivalent membership, and can be consumed by a fresh-process next-generation discovery invocation. Reuse DiscoveryBranchReplayBinding before inventing a new family where possible.
negative_ceiling: Does not show that one-generation I05 recursion is incorrect.
Does not show that branch-conditioned same-respondent cotravel is absent.
Does not require a new public semantic object family specifically; a strengthened existing receipt/binding may suffice.
Does not select or rank A/B/C physical carriers.
Does not test V3 developmental runtime.
